tasks.title: Status settings persist with independent revisions and service-only access
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, migration/storage/auth/status-route files and corresponding Checks; Decisions 3-5, 15-16; R2 status rows and common HTTP rules; Counterexamples (revisions, component order, tokens). Pin merged contract 2.4.0; append migration 9 with all five tables and both generations. Implement status settings/reports, runtime-admin/status-service/notify-service permissions, canGrant, shared auth throttle, admin/service dispatch and route labels. Keep reports outside configuration generations/audit; only configuration writes require quoted If-Match and atomically edit/bump/audit under the shared lock. Leave notify methods/routes to T2/T3. Status componentOrder uses current applied components. Document delivered routes and console-before-token rollout.

acceptance.command: bun test src/runtime-store.test.ts src/server.status-settings.test.ts src/server.service-auth.test.ts src/db.migrations.test.ts src/token-scopes.test.ts src/server.allow.test.ts src/server.scopes.test.ts src/backup.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. Step-8 fixture keeps checks, tokens, incidents and windows at version 9; backup includes all five new tables. Real port-0 status HTTP tests cover GET/PUT/report, 405 Allow, 401 missing, 403 read/cross-service/admin-on-service/service-on-admin, shared throttle, 413 over 1048576 bytes, 400 malformed If-Match, 428 missing, 412 stale, 422 invalid or unknown component. Status save audits status-settings.replace without values; service reports audit 0 rows. 100 reports leave the status ETag equal; channel/check and status revisions remain independent. Admin GET is 200 with no-store even with If-None-Match; service GET returns 304 for matching ETag; fresh at 180000 ms, stale at 180001 ms, never without a report.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.

tasks.title: Notify channel edits, reports and failed views honor precedence and aggregate limits
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, notify-channel/report/failed-view behavior and related Checks; Decisions 3-5, 12, 15-16; R1 notify views; R2 channel, report and failed rows; Counterexamples (whole channel, collisions, aggregate/report sizes, stale report, revisions). Extend T1 store/dispatch with channel CRUD, independent notify generation, service channel reads and observational reports, fresh/stale/never state and failed list. Shadowed ids come from the last report including a stale one; absent report means no shadowed ids. Enforce 100 records and 262144 UTF-8 bytes of JSON.stringify(definition) with the replacement candidate substituted, in the write transaction. Never resolve a secret. Preserve status/check revisions and no-store admin/304 service semantics.

acceptance.command: bun test src/runtime-store.test.ts src/server.notify-channels.test.ts src/server.service-auth.test.ts src/server.allow.test.ts src/server.scopes.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. Real HTTP tests give create 201+location, replace 200, delete 204, body/path mismatch 400, duplicate/file collision and shadowed PUT 409, unknown/file-only PUT 404, shadowed DELETE 204. Invalid refs, literal url and database file are 422. Exactly 262144 definition bytes accepted, 262145 refused 422; 101st channel refused 422; the 7th roughly 41000-byte webhook is 422 and service snapshot stays below 1048576 bytes. Missing/stale/malformed If-Match give 428/412/400. Status save does not stale channel PUT. 100 reports do not change notify ETag or audit; admin GET stays 200 no-store with updated report; matching service GET is 304. Reports have fresh/stale/never boundary 180000/180001 ms, stale shadowedIds still hide DB copies, and trimmed 524288-byte report is accepted 204. Sentinel PULSE_NOTIFY_SECRET_SENTINEL appears in 0 audit rows/log lines.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.

tasks.title: Resend commands recover idempotently and expire without changing configuration revisions
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, resend and retention behavior and Checks; Decision 14 complete create/claim/result state machine and retention; Decision 16; R2 resend rows; Counterexamples (Resend and stale report). Implement creation step order, requestId/open-command reuse, status lookup, capacity, 20 oldest claims, 60000-ms requeue and all idempotent acknowledgement pairs in transactions under the shared lock. Only a new 202 writes notify-resend.create; no report, claim or result changes a generation or audits. Retention deletes commands older than 7 days in every state. Keep the state machine together; do not defer lost-response recovery.

acceptance.command: bun test src/server.resend.test.ts src/runtime-store.test.ts src/server.service-auth.test.ts src/server.allow.test.ts src/server.scopes.test.ts src/retention.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. One requestId yields 202 then 200, one command and one audit row; different delivery with that requestId is 409. Each queued/claimed/admitted open command is reused with 200. Fresh at 180000 ms, stale at 180001 ms gives 503; absent failed item is 409. 1000 all-open rows give 503 'too many open resend commands' and retry-after 60; finished capacity is reclaimed oldest-first per Decision 14. Claim limit 20, requeue at 60000 not 59999 ms, admitted never requeued. All Decision 14 acknowledgement pairs have literal 204/409 expectations: repeat, requeued admission/final, final after lost admission and late admitted after final are accepted; contradictory final is 409; unknown id 404, queued/claimed result 422. 100 claims/reports leave notify ETag equal; service operations audit 0 rows. Seven-day retention includes open rows; expiry causes result 404. Every remaining R2 row has allowed/denied/method/body/metric-label checks.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.
